prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows damage along the right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover, with scrapes and a crease running toward the wheel arch, which fits the sideswipe the insured described during a lane change. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the quarter panel, and replacing the damaged rear marker light. The labor hours submitted match the scope of this work. The parts and labor lines on the invoices are not duplicated, and there is no record of prior damage to this vehicle in the file.
